column2: To try (doing), after a verb: 먹어 보다 = try eating
column3: the bare "To try" hides that this is the helper verb
That thing adds a "that" the word does not have
the "about" use is the one learners meet first

column2: To be so, to be like that
column3: That is right or yes is one use (그래요), not the meaning
distinguishes it from 그 (that, near you)

column2: Cannot do; to be worse than
Middle; during, in the middle of (회의 중 = in a meeting)
column3: the "during" use is the common one

column2: To be how (어때요? = How is it?)
To do so, to do like that
column3: And so, and then, well is 그래서/그러면, not 그러다

column2: Counter for things (사과 두 개 = two apples)
column3: Unit or piece hides how it is used

column2: To be seen, to be visible

column2: To come out, to happen (소리가 나다 = a sound is made)

Store is a suffix use (-점), not this word

column2: To be due to; 에 의하면 = according to
